recovery.title: Recover a render
recovery.ambiguous: The submission response was lost. The render may have been charged. Check the result in the same Comfy account and copy its identifier below. No new submission will be made.
recovery.confirm: I checked that this render matches the project, content and date shown.
recovery.connect: Connect the account that submitted the render.
recovery.busy: Another operation is running, or this browser cannot safely recover the render.
recovery.noSpend: Retrieves an existing submission without generating again.
recovery.invalid: Check the identifier and confirm that the render matches this receipt.
recovery.changed: The receipt changed or already has an identifier. Check its state before continuing.
recovery.account: Reconnect the account that submitted this render.
recovery.failed: Recovery is unavailable right now. The receipt is preserved.
recovery.corrupt: The receipt cannot be read. Keep this browser’s data and check your Comfy history.

safety.modelBlocked: Your model choices disable this action. No render was submitted.
safety.finalBlocked: Finalization currently uses RTX. A verified open-weights finalization is not connected yet. Local MP4 export remains available.
safety.estimate: The price is an estimate. The provider does not guarantee a billing cap.
safety.projectMissing: This project is not on this device. Import its backup to open it.
safety.sequenceMissing: This sequence is missing from the project. No other edit was opened in its place.
safety.referencesMax: This engine accepts at most {max} reference images. Reduce the references before generating.
safety.assetMissing: This media is missing from the requested project.

storage.title: Keep my projects
storage.persistent: This browser has granted protection against automatic storage eviction.
storage.best-effort: Your projects are saved here, but the browser may remove them if storage runs low.
storage.unsupported: This browser cannot verify protection against automatic storage eviction.
storage.unknown: Storage protection cannot be checked right now.
storage.refused: The browser did not grant protection. Download a copy of your studio.
storage.low: Storage is running low. Export a backup before adding large files.
storage.pending: The browser is still waiting for your answer. Check its permission prompt; you can already export a backup.
storage.backup: This protection is not a backup. “Export my studio” keeps an independent copy; clearing browser data still deletes local projects.

runtimeSafe.audioDecode: This video's sound cannot be decoded in this browser.

fiab.title: Operation reliability
fiab.changePrise: the engine may change the face, outfit or set from one take to the next, and does not guarantee the motion. Keep the best one: the others stay as versions, nothing is overwritten.
fiab.changeCast: the face and outfit may drift from your photos; the character is added only after the result, nothing is replaced.
fiab.changeDecor: light and details may drift from your text; the set is added next to the others, nothing is replaced.
